name: work
description: Paid or assigned work, including freelance work and work for family.

name: job search
description: Applications, resumes, cover letters, job boards, and interview prep.

name: networking
description: Conversations or messages with career contacts, including informational chats and follow-ups.

name: professional development
description: Learning and building skills for my field: courses, tutorials, reading about my field, and portfolio or skill-building projects.

name: admin
description: Paperwork, money, accounts, scheduling, and inbox upkeep: bills, taxes, forms, passwords, booking and rescheduling. Paperwork that serves one other category belongs to that category (an insurance claim is healthcare, application forms are job search). Never use for tasks that are not paperwork or logistics.

name: doomscrolling
description: Scrolling any app or site mindlessly or compulsively. Only when the text signals it.

name: social media
description: Chosen use of apps like Pinterest and BeReal, including browsing, posting, and commenting.

name: entertainment
description: Chosen content or routine viewing, alone or with others: TV, movies, YouTube videos, podcasts, music, and games. Not a ticketed or invited occasion.

name: events
description: Ticketed, invited, or formally scheduled occasions: ballet, concerts, theater, weddings, parties, games. Outranks entertainment, social time, and social meals.

name: texting
description: Messaging with friends and family. Career messages go to networking or job search.

name: social time
description: Time where interacting with people is the activity: visits, talking, calls and video calls, hanging out.

name: sleep
description: Sleeping, and lying in bed trying to fall asleep.

name: exercise
description: Workouts, walks for fitness, sports, and stretching.

name: functional meals
description: Preparing and eating ordinary meals, alone or with the people I live with. Dishes and cleanup are chores.

name: social meals
description: Meals out or hosted where the meal is also the social occasion. Formally invited meals are events.

name: chores
description: Housework inside the home: cleaning, laundry, dishes, tidying.

name: errands
description: Necessary tasks outside the home: groceries, bank, post office, returns.

name: shopping
description: Browsing or buying things I want, in store or online.

name: reading
description: Reading books or long-form pieces for pleasure. Reading about my field is professional development.

name: piano
description: Playing, practicing, or learning piano.

name: hobbies
description: Hobbies without their own category: crafts, baking for fun, writing, journaling. Specifics go in the label.

name: hygiene
description: Daily basics: showering, brushing teeth, getting dressed, skincare routine.

name: personal care
description: Occasional or discretionary care: hair, nails, spa, massage, self-care sessions.

name: healthcare
description: Appointments, medication, therapy, and related pharmacy trips.

name: vacation
description: Everything while on a trip, from leaving home until returning. Overrides all other categories.
